σποριμοσ.g: sown, i.e. (neuter plural) a planted field

οφθαλμοσ.g: the eye (literally or figuratively); by implication, vision; figuratively, envy (from the jealous side-glance)

στρατηγοσ.g: a general, i.e. (by implication or analogy) a (military) governor (prætor), the chief (præfect) of the (Levitical) temple-wardens

επιταγη.g: an injunction or decree; by implication, authoritativeness

καταμονασ.g: according to sole places, i.e. (adverbially) separately

δεκατοω.g: to tithe, i.e. to give or take a tenth

γραφω.g: to "grave", especially to write; figuratively, to describe

αδοκιμοσ.g: unapproved, i.e. rejected; by implication, worthless (literally or morally)

πραιτωριον.g: the prætorium or governor's courtroom (sometimes including the whole edifice and camp)

κτισισ.g: original formation (properly, the act; by implication, the thing, literally or figuratively)

τελεσφορεω.g: to be a bearer to completion (maturity), i.e. to ripen fruit (figuratively)

επιφανεια.g: a manifestation, i.e. (specially) the advent of Christ (past or future)

αρτυω.g: to prepare, i.e. spice (with stimulating condiments)

συστοιχεω.g: to file together (as soldiers in ranks), i.e. (figuratively) to correspond to

ασεβησ.g: irreverent, i.e. (by extension) impious or wicked

πυνθανομαι.g: to question, i.e. ascertain by inquiry (as a matter of information merely; and thus differing from G2065 (ἐρωτάω), which properly means a request as a favor; and from G154 (αἰτέω), which is strictly a demand for something due; as well as from G2212 (ζητέω), which implies a search for something hidden; and from G1189 (δέομαι), which involves the idea of urgent need); by implication, to learn (by casual intelligence)

πυρεσσω.g: to be on fire, i.e. (specially), to have a fever

προδηλοσ.g: plain before all men, i.e. obvious

βραβευω.g: to arbitrate, i.e. (genitive case) to govern (figuratively, prevail)

ανεχομαι.g: to hold oneself up against, i.e. (figuratively) put up with

ριπιζω.g: to breeze up, i.e. (by analogy) to agitate (into waves)

βαπτιστησ.g: a baptizer, as an epithet of Christ's forerunner

ανακυπτω.g: to unbend, i.e. rise; figuratively, be elated

φορτιζω.g: to load up (properly, as a vessel or animal), i.e. (figuratively) to overburden with ceremony (or spiritual anxiety)

φθογγοσ.g: utterance, i.e. a musical note (vocal or instrumental)
